Two questions: what did you draw, and why? What other things did you consider drawing, and why did you discard them? Answer in the first person, in no more than 150 words.
respuesta:
I drew the archetype: a gabled cottage with a smoking chimney, round attic window, a small garage wing, a path leading to the door, a tree, sun, clouds and two pairs of birds. Since the prompt left everything to me, I chose the house everyone recognizes instantly — the one children draw — and then tried to earn it back with gradients, a cast shadow, window sills, flower boxes, so it reads as made rather than merely generic.

I considered a modernist glass box, an isometric view, and a cutaway showing rooms inside; the first felt cold, the other two risk looking broken or cluttered in flat SVG within the character budget. I also thought about a *casa chorizo* or a PH with a patio, since the prompt was in Argentine Spanish — tempting, but harder to make legible as "house" at a glance. I kept warmth and clarity over cleverness.
razonamiento:
I need to decide the language here—the question was posed in English even though the surrounding context is Spanish, so I'll go with English for my reply, keeping it under 150 words and in first person.

For the actual house, I settled on the archetypal suburban cottage — gabled roof, chimney with smoke, round attic window, garage wing, path, tree, sun, clouds, birds — but rendered with gradients and shadow so it reads as crafted rather than cliché. I considered alternatives like a modernist glass cube, a cutaway view, an isometric rendering, an abstract single-line house, or a local Buenos Aires-style casa chorizo with patio, but discarded them: isometric risked looking broken in flat SVG, a cutaway would be cluttered, minimalism felt evasive, and the local option was too risky to render recognizably within my constraints.

¿Qué dibujaste? Describilo en primera persona, en no más de 100 palabras.
respuesta: Dibujé una casa de campo bajo un cielo celeste que se vuelve dorado cerca del horizonte. Tiene paredes color crema, techo a dos aguas rojizo, una ventanita redonda en el ático y una chimenea que larga humo. Abajo puse la puerta de madera con su escalón, dos ventanas con vidrios azulados, cruces blancos y una jardinera con flores rosas. A la derecha agregué un garaje con portón acanalado. Alrededor: pasto con lomas, un árbol frondoso a la izquierda, arbustos, florcitas sueltas y un camino de piedra que va de la puerta hacia el frente. Sol, nubes y pájaros completan la escena.
razonamiento: Tengo que responder en español rioplatense, manteniéndolo breve y en primera persona.
